name: websitetoprompt
description: This Chrome extension allows you to select webpage elements and convert them into Markdown. Your selections are automatically saved as prompts, which can be managed, exported, or deleted through the Prompt Management Dashboard.

scripts.test: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/repo:ro -w /repo mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.59.1-noble bash -c 'npm i --silent --no-save --prefix /tmp/pw playwright@1.59.1 && NODE_PATH=/tmp/pw/node_modules node tests/e2e.js'
scripts.pack: npm run build && rm -f WebsiteToPrompt.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../WebsiteToPrompt.zip .

author: https://github.com/jac-marais
